Similarly, the Price-to-Book (P/B) ratio of 23.16x [E7] is also far above the sector average of 2.76x, suggesting that the market values the company's assets at an inflated level. These high multiples imply that the current valuation may not be supported by the underlying fundamentals and could be driven by speculative buying or other non-fundamental factors. However, these ratios should be considered in context with other metrics.
